services.name: Sunset Sail
services.desc: When you set out to build something special, oftentimes it ends up looking nothing like the initial visions, nor like the first versions. That is precisely what is happening with Anderson Island Youth Sailing. The initial thought, a few years back now, was... "Let's take the kids sailing!", and that is what we did. Sure, they learned some things along the way, such as Hide & Seek is not a game made for a 30' sailboat and 8 hours on a sailboat is a long day, as beautiful as that day may be. Sure, they also got the opportunity to pull lines and steer, as well as visit some really neat places that most kids do not get the chance to see in such a cool way. services.desc: Book a one-way charter from Steilacoom to Anderson Island. Consider this your backup option if you miss the ferry, or take the fun scenic way across. (To book a trip less than 24hrs out, please call/text/email Captain Corey directly -- subject to extra fee.) You may cancel for a full refund up until 14 days prior to sailing date.
